mentions.name: TCO Estimator for Internal Apps
mentions.description: A small tool that estimates total cost of ownership (TCO) for internal apps. It compares different approaches and makes assumptions explicit, serving as a rough instrument to sanity-check effort and tradeoffs.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I’m tinkering with a small TCO estimator for internal apps.

It compares different approaches and makes some assumptions explicit.
Mostly a rough tool to sanity-check effort and tradeoffs.
